request.brief: A historical documentary style image representing Ottoman officers asked for guarantees during negotiations about the possible restoration of Abdülhamid II, around 1910. Depict a small group of period-correct Ottoman officers in dark uniforms and fez caps gathered outside an Istanbul government building. Use the historical officers photograph as subject and dress reference only; do not imply a real documented event. Restrained monochrome news photography, no text or symbols.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV report event picture: A historical documentary style image representing Ottoman officers asked for guarantees during negotiations about the possible restoration of Abdülhamid II, around 1910. Depict a small group of period-correct Ottoman officers in dark uniforms and fez caps gathered outside an Istanbul government building. Use the historical officers photograph as subject and dress reference only; do not imply a real documented event. Restrained monochrome news photography, no text or symbols.

Requirements:
- A documentary-style scene that fills the whole frame, composed for a 210x176 crop.
- The report-card treatment (sepia, grain, tilt, shadow) is applied afterwards by the tool, so do not draw a border, a shadow or a tilt.

Style:
- Match the mod's existing report event picture art: muted, low-saturation, mid-tone palette dominated by dark grey, black and white; little or no dark outline; crisp, detailed texture; about 87% of the canvas covered by the subject (measured on 24 images).

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
2. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
3. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
4. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
5. subject anchor: depict this subject
The reference images come from this mod. Match the form and framing of the mod's reference images; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.
The reference images were chosen automatically from this mod's art and show its style and form only: never copy their emblem, subject or composition. Vary the composition within the range the mod's art shows, and draw this brief's own subject.

Avoid: text, captions or headlines; watermark or signature; a frame or border.

Produce exactly one image.

style_sources.method: descriptors (Lab mean/std, saturation, Sobel edge density, alpha coverage, dark-outline share, 6-bin hue histogram) are standardised; deterministic k-medoids (PAM, no random start, candidates ordered by content hash) picks up to 24 images for statistics and drift. Up to 4 images are sent: a pinned style as ordered; otherwise nation-specific files are left out unless the brief names the country, about half the slots are drawn from the files whose names best match the brief's words and themes and the rest from the family's most style-typical generic files, all seeded by a hash of the family, asset and brief
